name: Star Chroma
author: toasty-wheeler
description: Razer Chroma lighting for Starsector. Campaign: ability keys 1-0 glow light blue when ready and red while in use or cooling down; Tab, E, C, F, R, I glow light blue. Combat: everything goes white, shields fill blue from the bottom up, flux heats the lights to red-orange, hull damage makes keys flicker, glitch and die, and losing your flagship sets off an explosion. Needs Razer Synapse / Razer Chroma app running. Safe to add or remove at any time.
